$comment: Single source of truth for KB check rules. scripts/generate-rule-registry.mjs emits the TS rule registry, the kb_check input enum, and packages/core/src/rule_registry.pl from this file. PrologPredicate is the checks.pl aggregated predicate; prologPredicateArity accounts for option-taking predicates (symbol-traceability).

rules.name: must-priority-coverage
rules.description: Every must-priority requirement must have a scenario and a test

rules.name: symbol-coverage
rules.description: Production symbols need qualifying coverage via covered_by plus a canonical requirement/scenario test path

rules.name: symbol-traceability
rules.description: Production symbols must directly implement requirements for ownership; covered_by is coverage only and executable_for is test identity only

rules.name: no-dangling-refs
rules.description: All relationship targets must exist in the KB

rules.name: source-relationship-parity
rules.description: Authored Markdown and relationship-shard edges must exactly match the compiled KB

rules.name: no-cycles
rules.description: No circular dependency chains in requirements

rules.name: required-fields
rules.description: All entities must have required fields

rules.name: deprecated-adr-no-successor
rules.description: Deprecated ADRs must have a successor ADR that supersedes them

rules.name: scenario-feasibility
rules.description: A scenario that expects success must not assume a property value a current requirement forbids, unless an approved exception requirement exempts it

rules.name: domain-contradictions
rules.description: Detect contradictions between requirements constraining the same fact

rules.name: logic-coverage
rules.description: Require every explicitly declared atomic requirement claim to be grounded by a linked strict-property or predicate fact

rules.name: rule-safety
rules.description: Stored Logic IR rules use only the typed, bounded, stratified vocabulary

rules.name: rule-verifiability
rules.description: Requirement rule links resolve to safe rules and registered rule schemas

rules.name: query-plan-safety
rules.description: Detect Prolog validation clauses that place negation before generator calls

rules.name: req-status-vocabulary
rules.description: Requirement statuses must use the canonical vocabulary (open, in_progress, closed; legacy: active, approved); ADR statuses such as accepted silently fall out of the proof ladder

rules.name: strict-fact-shape
rules.description: Detect malformed strict facts (facts with fact_kind that are missing required fields)

rules.name: strict-req-fact-pairing
rules.description: Detect requirements with incomplete strict subject/property fact pairing for contradiction-safe semantics

rules.name: predicate-verifiability
rules.description: Detect requires_predicate links that do not target ground fact_kind: predicate facts

rules.name: strict-readiness
rules.description: Report strict contradiction-readiness levels for requirements that are still prose-only or otherwise not contradiction-ready

rules.name: semantic-completeness
rules.description: Every inventoried assertive proposition is modeled or explicitly classified

rules.name: proof-contract-symbols
rules.description: Detect unresolved required_proofs.symbol_id values, type-shape required proofs, and proof_bindings.source_file disagreement with the named symbol sourceFile

rules.name: entity-id-style
rules.description: Entity IDs name the governed behavior and match their filename stem; new purely numeric IDs are reported at creation boundaries

rules.name: domain-redundancy
rules.description: Two current requirements must not ground the identical logical term or share a ground fact unless linked by supersedes or restates

rules.name: domain-implication
rules.description: Informational: one requirement's numeric bound strictly implies another requirement's bound on the same subject and property

rules.name: subject-key-identity
rules.description: Subject keys must name a shared component, not be derived from a requirement ID

rules.name: subject-key-shape
rules.description: Subject keys follow dotted component.aspect[.sub] with lowercase snake segments

rules.name: ontology-quality
rules.description: Informational: predicate schemas whose argument values mostly occur in only one fact are carrying prose instead of a shared vocabulary

rules.name: predicate-schema-conformance
rules.description: Predicate facts match a predicate_schema (project-local, or the built-in catalog in the default namespace) and use its declared argument constants
